name: Launch Table
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web dashboard composition study, 16:10 landscape viewport
Primary request: Design a sophisticated Hyperion service dashboard named Hyperion using the approved Service Atlas visual system. This is a designed web interface, not a poster or physical scene.
Structure: a quiet top navigation with the brand at left and four labeled destinations. Make the first half of the viewport a search-first launch table: a prominent wide Find a service command field, then a single horizontal strip of five frequently opened service destinations with name, endpoint, status, and explicit Open actions—connected by one thin brass bearing line, not separate floating cards. At right, a compact vertical Current bearing panel summarizes fleet state. The lower half becomes a full-width dense service index with category filters and one selected row revealing a shallow inline detail and log preview. Prioritize opening a known service in seconds while still supporting browsing.
Style/medium: refined production-grade SaaS UI mockup, cartographic editorial precision, flat semantic interface.
Color palette: warm mineral ivory #F4F0E6, parchment #FBF8F0, limestone #E4DDCF, carbon #282824, graphite #615F57, rare aged brass #876721, restrained green/ochre/red service states. Gold occupies less than ten percent.
Materials/textures: matte paper and engraved wayfinding implied only through tone, hairline rules, coordinate alignment, and tiny plotted bearings; no literal paper texture.
Typography: distinctive compact contemporary grotesk with a subtly human technical display voice; large but operational title, strong service names, disciplined labels.
Text verbatim: Hyperion, Your deployed world, within reach., and Find a service.
Constraints: direct open-service actions must be obvious; status never uses gold; accessibility-conscious contrast; show illustrative service entries without real-company claims; no hero marketing layout.
Avoid: Greek letters, blue, columns, laurels, temples, amphorae, parchment cosplay, ornamental mythology, generic card grid, glassmorphism, gradients, neon, excessive gold, dark mode, poster composition, photorealism, device frame, watermark.
